elements.requirement: Section 200(1) or (2) does not apply to the exercise of an intelligence service's power to retain or examine a bulk personal dataset if the intelligence service obtained that dataset under a warrant or other authorisation issued or given under the Investigatory Powers Act 2016.
elements.quote: Section 200(1) or (2) does not apply to the exercise of a power of an intelligence service to retain or (as the case may be) examine a bulk personal dataset if the intelligence service obtained the bulk personal dataset under a warrant or other authorisation issued or given under this Act.

elements.requirement: Section 200(1) or (2) does not apply at any time when a bulk personal dataset is being retained or examined for the purpose of enabling any information contained within it to be destroyed.
elements.quote: Section 200(1) or (2) does not apply at any time when a bulk personal dataset is being retained or (as the case may be) examined for the purpose of enabling any of the information contained in it to be destroyed.

elements.requirement: Sections 210(8), 219(8), 220(5) and (6), and 226CC(3) provide for other exceptions to section 200(1) or (2) in connection with initial examinations, the non-renewal or cancellation of BPD warrants or authorisations under Part 7A, and cases where a Judicial Commissioner refuses to approve a specific BPD warrant.
elements.quote: Sections 210(8), 219(8) , 220(5) and (6) and 226CC(3) provide for other exceptions to section 200(1) or (2) (in connection with cases where a Judicial Commissioner refuses to approve a specific BPD warrant, the non-renewal or cancellation of BPD warrants or authorisations under Part 7A and initial examinations).
